name: view_stack_creep_plate_names_its_wave
description: A selected creep's plate names the creep's own wave (M8's review; design 2.7 and 5.7): with waves 1 and 2 on the road together, a Gourdling of wave 1 says 'Wave 1' and one of wave 2 'Wave 2', where the plate named the newest wave on the road for every creep. tools/play/describe.gd reads the same plate.

steps.assert: older > 0 and younger > 0 and Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1, 2])
steps.msg: a creep of each wave on the road
wave 1's creep says wave 1, though wave 2 is the newest
